subject: Renewal: basketed commit proposal & per-token floor structure
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Pete Harris <pete@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal: basketed commit proposal & per-token floor structure

Hi Pete —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation, GreenWave is deep into the renewal window and wants a structure that gives you per-token predictability but also flexibility across three product buckets (inference, embeddings, and fine-tune). Rather than a single gross commit, our proposal below splits the annual commit into a basket of tranches with a blended floor and explicit uplift caps.

High-level proposed structure (draft):
- Basketed commit: 120M tokens annual commitment split as 80% inference / 15% embeddings / 5% fine-tune buckets.
- Per-token floor: a bucket-specific floor price (inference $0.0008, embeddings $0.0018, fine-tune $0.0045) when consumption reaches committed %s.
- Upside cap: renewal uplift ceiling of +20% on effective blended rate year-over-year unless GreenWave exercises a one-time expansion option.
- Mid-year true-up: quarterly lookbacks with a single true-up to reconcile delivered vs committed; no retroactive clawbacks beyond the true-up quarter.

I attached a quick spreadsheet with the matrix and examples showing three consumption scenarios. If this looks reasonable, Marissa and I can translate into CLM-friendly language and attach a DocuSign.

Open questions from our side:
1) Are you comfortable with the bucket splits being advisory vs prescriptive (i.e., GreenWave can shift intra-year but must maintain the blended floor unless change exceeds 30% movement)?
2) Is a single blended uplift cap acceptable, or do you prefer per-bucket ceilings?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: redwood-pricing-matrix-2026.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]

From: Pete Harris <pete@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal: basketed commit proposal & per-token floor structure

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. The basket idea is interesting and could map nicely to our product teams. A few quick notes from procurement and finance:
- Procurement wants to avoid per-bucket penalties that move budget between departments unexpectedly — so we prefer advisory splits, as you suggested.
- Finance is asking for a hard cap on year-over-year price increases (the +20% sounds reasonable) but wants an explicit carve-out for a usage-triggered price reset if we exceed 150% of committed tokens in any single bucket.
- We need SOW / usage reporting to be delivered monthly to our billing system.

I'll loop in procurement (procurement@greenwavehealth.com) and get back with a preferred time for a call.

Best,
Pete Harris
Director of Product Ops, GreenWave Health
[pete@greenwavehealth.com]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Pete Harris <pete@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal: basketed commit proposal & per-token floor structure

Pete — thanks. Quick answers inline and attached a short "playbook" with the reporting cadence and sample clauses for the true-up and usage-triggered reset.

- Advisory bucket splits: agreed — we'll allow intra-year reallocation up to 30% movement without touching floor pricing. Any move >30% will trigger a re-evaluation and pro-rated floor adjustment.
- YoY uplift cap: we'll keep +20% blended as our default. The usage-triggered reset (150% threshold) is acceptable but we propose a staged reset: hitting 150% triggers a notice and 30-day remediation window; exceeding 200% allows Redwood to move the customer onto a higher tranche pricing for the remainder of the quarter (documented and limited).
- Reporting: monthly export (CSV), and an aggregated monthly summary PDF. We'll add a clause mapping the CSV fields to your billing system fields in the playbook.

Attached: Greenwave_Renewal_Playbook_v2.pdf and proposal-basketed-commit-2026.docx.

Can Marissa follow up with concrete discount tiers and a sample contract redline?

Jordan

[Attachment: Greenwave_Renewal_Playbook_v2.pdf (pdf, 85KB)]
[Attachment: proposal-basketed-commit-2026.docx (docx, 28KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Pete Harris <pete@greenwavehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal: basketed commit proposal & per-token floor structure

Pete — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a concise discount ladder we can sign to today. Key points:

- Baseline (no commit): inference $0.0012 / token, embeddings $0.0026 / token, fine-tune $0.0065 / token.
- Basket floors at commit levels: 50M, 90M, 120M with corresponding per-token floor reductions. Example (blended):
  - 50M commit -> blended floor = $0.00098 / token (5% off baseline)
  - 90M commit -> blended floor = $0.00086 / token (12% off baseline)
  - 120M commit -> blended floor = $0.00075 / token (20% off baseline)
- True-up mechanics: quarterly lookbacks with a single cumulative reconciliation at year-end; mid-year remediation window per Jordan's note.
- One-time renewal uplift cap: +20% on blended effective rate. If GreenWave grows >150% in a bucket, we allow the staged reset described.

A couple of asks from finance: we need a commitment term (12 vs 24 months) to price the 20% floor at 120M — 24 months will get slightly deeper discounts. Also need to lock in the reporting CSV format to avoid reconciliation disputes.

If these levels look OK, I'll prepare a draft amendment for signature (DocuSign).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[marissa.cole@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: redwood-pricing-matrix-2026.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Pete Harris <pete@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal: basketed commit proposal & per-token floor structure

Looping in from finance/pricing — happy with the proposed floors and the staged reset language subject to the following guardrails:

1) Any usage-triggered reset needs a 30-day written notice and a single 30-day remediation window; pricing changes only apply prospectively after the remediation window.
2) We will not apply retroactive clawbacks beyond the single true-up reconciliation at year-end.
3) For commitments >= 120M on a 24-month term, we can extend the blended floor by an additional 3% discount (finalized in the amendment).

Marissa — please proceed with the amendment draft and indicate whether GreenWave prefers a 12- or 24-month term. Pete — once you confirm term preference we'll draft the DocuSign and aim to have an executed amendment within two weeks.

-Aditya
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference
[aditya.rao@redwood.ai]
